fact: Registration and transfer of pupils for the 2026-2027 school year began on Monday 28 September 2026 through the Siraj platform, on the timetable set by the Ministry of Education and Reform of the Education System; registration, transfers and correction of pupils' status run until 20 October, and the ministry called on parents to register their children early.
title: انطلاق تسجيل وتحويل التلاميذ عبر منصة «سراج»
